records.title: Museum Studies
records.text: TNPRFT 449 Museum Studies (5) SSc Introduces the history, philosophy, organization, administration, and practice of museums. Covers the changing emphases on the role of museums in cultural, socioeconomic and political contexts; collection management, exhibition and program planning, education, cultural tourism, community outreach, and marketing.

records.title: Essentials of Grant Writing
records.header: TNPRFT 451 Essentials of Grant Writing (5) SSc
records.text: TNPRFT 451 Essentials of Grant Writing (5) SSc Prepares students to be grant writers in the nonprofit sector. Provides an overview of the best practices, systems, and management principles underlying successful grant writing programs including developing a case statement, and subsequently, writing and submitting a grant application.
